description: Synthetic project-owned profile: Node API, React web client, PostgreSQL and PM2 delivery behind Nginx.
compatibility_rules: The project owns this profile; the platform validates only its schema and that every slot names a preferred catalog component.
Frameworks the catalog does not carry stay pinned in the application lock file and are not architecture slots.

constraints.deployment: pm2-legacy describes delivery ownership only and grants no deployment capability.
constraints.data_storage: PostgreSQL data resides on approved persistent storage owned by the host.
constraints.concurrency: Connection and worker limits are owned by each application Change.
constraints.availability: Availability topology is declared outside this architecture lock.
constraints.backup: A database major Change requires a verified backup before mutation.
constraints.restore_drill: A restore drill is required before production adoption of a new PostgreSQL major.
